description: Adds the user's own e-mail address to a trial. The trial grows to 10 addresses in total and the user gets a WozApi account without a password (they log in with a code sent by e-mail). Only use an address the user typed.

email.description: Optional. The user's own e-mail address, only if the user typed it. Never invent one.

trial_code.description: The trial_code from start_trial. Leave empty when the user is signed in to WozApi or the connection has a WozApi API key.

name: add_trial_email
title: E-mailadres aan de proef toevoegen
